# Generated by workspace/agot_adventurer_tweaks. Redefines the AGOT decisions
# agot_expose_my_true_parentage_decision and agot_royal_bastard_claim_decision
# so landless adventurers can use them. Must load after A Game of Thrones.

agot_expose_my_true_parentage_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	desc = agot_expose_my_true_parentage_decision_desc
	is_shown = {
		exists = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
		knows_self_royal_bastard_secret = yes
		NOT = { owns_story_of_type = agot_royal_bastard_story }
		NOT = { has_character_flag = awaiting_bastardry_result }
	}
	is_valid = {
		is_adult = yes
		OR = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_landless_adventurer = yes
		}
		prestige_level >= 1
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_at_home = yes
	}

	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = agot_expose_my_true_parentage_decision_tooltip
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_child = {
					even_if_dead = yes
					house = prev.house
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = agot_expose_my_true_parentage_decision_cadet_tooltip
		}
		random_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				secret_type = secret_agot_disputed_heritage
				secret_target = root
			}
			save_scope_as = heritage_secret
		}
		random_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				secret_type = secret_disputed_heritage
				secret_target = root
			}
			save_scope_as = heritage_secret
		}
		random_known_secret = {
			limit = {
				secret_type = secret_unmarried_illegitimate_child
				secret_target = root
			}
			save_scope_as = heritage_secret
		}
		save_scope_as = revealer
		add_character_flag = awaiting_bastardry_result
		add_unpressed_claim = title:h_the_iron_throne
		add_unpressed_claim = title:e_the_crownlands
		add_unpressed_claim = title:k_the_blackwater
		add_unpressed_claim = title:d_kings_landing
		add_unpressed_claim = title:c_kings_landing
		add_unpressed_claim = title:k_dragonstone
		add_unpressed_claim = title:d_dragonstone
		add_unpressed_claim = title:c_dragonstone
		trigger_event = {
			id = agot_events_bastard.0950
			days = { 7 14 }
		}
	}


	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	# odd number to ensure lack of predictability in month of trigger
	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 13
		duchy = 13
		kingdom = 13
		empire = 13
		hegemony = 13
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 10
		ai_value_modifier = {
			who = root
			ai_boldness = low_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Very bold, risking your life for a claim
			ai_greed = low_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Want the throne and its power
			ai_honor = tiny_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Claiming rightful identity
			ai_compassion = tiny_chance_impact_negative_ai_value # Will cause conflict and suffering
			ai_rationality = tiny_chance_impact_negative_ai_value # Risky move with uncertain outcome
			max = 50
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 25
			has_trait = honest
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 25
			has_trait = just
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -30
			has_trait = deceitful
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 20
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -10
			has_trait = content
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -15
			has_trait = paranoid
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			has_trait = arrogant
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			has_trait = greedy
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -5
			has_trait = humble
		}
		opinion_modifier = {
			opinion_target = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
			who = root
			multiplier = -0.15
		}
		modifier = { # Good relations are a bit less likely
			factor = 0.8
			root = {
				OR = {
					has_relation_best_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_soldier_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_lover = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_soulmate = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_ward = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
				}
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Bad relations are more likely though
			factor = 1.2
			root = {
				OR = {
					has_relation_nemesis = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_rival = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
				}
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Doing this in debt /could/ be bad
			factor = 0.5
			root = {
				debt_level > 0
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Ai shouldn't if they're king just to avoid weird acting against own interest
			factor = 0
			title:h_the_iron_throne.holder = {
				this = root
			}
		}
	}
}

agot_royal_bastard_claim_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_character_flag = forswore_royal_claims }
				desc = agot_royal_bastard_claim_decision_desc.forswore
			}
			desc = agot_royal_bastard_claim_decision_desc
		}
	}
	is_shown = {
		exists = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
		title:h_the_iron_throne.holder != root
		has_character_flag = royal_bastard
		NOT = { has_character_flag = awaiting_bastardry_result }
		NOT = { has_character_flag = pressing_own_bastard_claim }
		NOT = { owns_story_of_type = agot_royal_bastard_story }
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_nw }
	}
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_landless_adventurer = yes
		}
		is_adult = yes
		is_incapable = no
		is_at_home = yes
		is_at_war = no
		NOT = { any_truce_target = { this = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder } } # No true breaking!
		prestige_level >= 2
	}

	effect = {
		title:h_the_iron_throne.holder = { save_scope_as = ruler_scope }
		custom_tooltip = agot_royal_bastard_claim_decision_tooltip
		add_character_flag = pressing_own_bastard_claim
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_flag = forswore_royal_claims }
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = agot_reversed_claim_forswear
			}
			add_prestige = -150
			add_unpressed_claim = title:h_the_iron_throne
			add_unpressed_claim = title:e_the_crownlands
			add_unpressed_claim = title:k_the_blackwater
			add_unpressed_claim = title:d_kings_landing
			add_unpressed_claim = title:c_kings_landing
			add_unpressed_claim = title:k_dragonstone
			add_unpressed_claim = title:d_dragonstone
			add_unpressed_claim = title:c_dragonstone
		}
		# Setting some variables to avoid the story erroring out
		set_variable = {
			name = revealer_passthrough
			value = root
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = bastard_passthrough
			value = root
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = real_father_passthrough
			value = root.father
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = real_mother_passthrough
			value = root.mother
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = rb_pressing_claim_directly
			value = flag:true
		}
		create_story = agot_royal_bastard_story
	}


	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	# odd number to ensure lack of predictability in month of trigger
	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 13
		duchy = 13
		kingdom = 13
		empire = 13
		hegemony = 13
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 5
		ai_value_modifier = {
			who = root
			ai_boldness = low_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Most aggressive action, needs boldness
			ai_greed = low_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Throne-seeking ambition
			ai_honor = low_chance_impact_negative_ai_value # Aggressive claim, especially if forsworn
			ai_compassion = low_chance_impact_negative_ai_value # Will cause war and death
			ai_rationality = tiny_chance_impact_negative_ai_value # Risky gamble
			ai_vengefulness = tiny_chance_impact_positive_ai_value # Resentment toward current ruler
			max = 75
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -40 # This is considered dishonourable and unless they REALLY want to they shouldn't
			has_character_flag = forswore_royal_claims
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 20
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -20
			has_trait = content
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			has_trait = arrogant
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			has_trait = greedy
		}
		modifier = {
			add = -10
			has_trait = humble
		}
		opinion_modifier = {
			opinion_target = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
			who = root
			multiplier = -0.25
		}
		modifier = { # Good relations should't do this as it's extremely hostile
			factor = 0
			root = {
				OR = {
					has_relation_best_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_soldier_friend = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_lover = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_soulmate = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_ward = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
				}
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Bad relations are more likely though
			factor = 1.5
			root = {
				OR = {
					has_relation_nemesis = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
					has_relation_rival = title:h_the_iron_throne.holder
				}
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Doing this in debt would just be dumb
			factor = 0
			root = {
				debt_level > 0
			}
		}
	}
}
